description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for a PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) processor in a 5G NR simulation or implementation, including configuration parameters, notifier interface, and validation interface.

classes.name: pdsch_processor_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifications upon completion of PDSCH processing.

classes.name: pdsch_processor
classes.description: Interface for processing PDSCH transmissions, including configuration and processing methods.

classes.name: pdsch_pdu_validator
classes.description: Interface for validating PDSCH processing configuration parameters.

methods.name: on_finish_processing
methods.description: Callback invoked when PDSCH processing is finished.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a PDSCH transmission given resource grid, notifier, data codewords, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Validates the PDSCH processing configuration parameters.
